entities.description: A close-up view of a closed, light brown corrugated cardboard box featuring a black oval handle cutout on the right side and sealed with strips of clear packing tape. The box is positioned on top of another cardboard box, with a blurry background showing a person's hand and blue clothing.

A close-up view of a large, plain brown cardboard box with a smaller, sealed cardboard box resting on top of it. The larger box occupies the majority of the frame, showing its flat, matte surface and the top edge where the flaps meet, while the smaller box above displays a strip of packing tape sealing its top seam.

attributes.sealing: packing tape visible on top box

entities.description: A rectangular package wrapped in plain brown kraft paper, secured with a wide, dark blue satin ribbon that runs vertically around the box. The paper wrapping features diagonal creases at the corners, creating a neat, folded appearance.

A close-up view of a plain, light brown cardboard box sealed with strips of translucent packing tape at the corners and along the top seam. The box is positioned on top of another box, with a partial view of a third box visible on the right edge.

attributes.position: stacked on top of another box

entities.description: A close-up view of two stacked cardboard boxes, with the top box resting on the bottom one. The boxes are made of light brown corrugated cardboard and are sealed with clear packing tape along the seams.

A medium-sized, plain brown cardboard box is sealed with strips of clear packing tape on the top and bottom edges of its front face. The box is positioned on top of another cardboard box, with a small portion of a second box visible on top of it.

A close-up view of a person's hands holding a blue clipboard with a silver metal clip at the top. The person is wearing a dark, short-sleeved shirt, and their fingers are visible gripping the sides of the board.

A young Asian woman with long, dark brown hair is looking down with a slight smile while writing on a blue clipboard held in her left hand. She is wearing a dark, long-sleeved collared shirt and is positioned behind several stacked brown cardboard boxes.

clothing.top: dark blue or black long-sleeved shirt

attributes.pose: seated or standing behind boxes, holding clipboard
